description: OAuth 后 403 / UsernameNotFound 修复（失败路径）

input.task_desc: OAuth flow succeeded but /2/users/me returns 403 UsernameNotFound

strategy.diagnosis: Token bound to default profile instead of named app, or /2/users/me call broken
strategy.fix: User must re-run xurl auth oauth2 --app my-app YOUR_USERNAME outside agent session (XURL-004, XURL-006)
strategy.agent_action: Do NOT execute auth commands; direct user to manual fix

result.diagnosis: 403 on /2/users/me after OAuth — token not bound to named app
fix_steps: User runs: xurl auth oauth2 --app my-app YOUR_USERNAME (outside agent session)
User runs: xurl auth default my-app
Verify: xurl auth status shows token bound to my-app
